observed.failure: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error from ComfyUI /prompt

truth_boundary: The runner increments generation_count only after /prompt returns a prompt_id, so local count remained zero. This does not by itself prove the backend performed no work before returning HTTP 500. A read-only postmortem must inspect preserved server logs and any BASE output artifact before asserting backend generation_count=0.

diagnostic.scope: Read preserved BASE.api_prompt.json and BASE.workflow.json, enumerate key compiled node inputs, search for BASE output files created during the v0.8.3 run window, and tail preserved ComfyUI stdout/stderr logs.
